capabilities: Add words as notes with definitions and example sentences via command palette
Mass-import word lists pasted as text
Import saved words from a Kobo eReader linked to their books
Capture words from web pages via a companion Chrome extension
Show a table view of the lexicon with familiarity scores
extras: Offline mode requires a one-time ~23MB download (167K English entries derived from Wiktionary) stored in the plugin folder; online mode sends lookups to api.dictionaryapi.dev. README states no analytics or account are used.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up a word's definition and save it as a note linked back to where you encountered it.

relations.evidence: The lookup goes to the free Dictionary API by default

summary: Personal dictionary plugin that saves words as vault notes with definitions, example sentences, source links, and a lexicon table view.
